purpose: Owner-reviewable Phase 1 evidence. This file is not imported by the application and is not runtime route, status, or authorization authority.
invariants: The contract must never be imported into runtime application code
Route registration does not prove that every capability behind a route is live or available
Authorization remains owned by components, providers, backend controls, RLS, RPCs, Workers, APIs, and participation contracts
Dynamic destinations must come from the named record source; the contract does not authorize arbitrary IDs
Legacy /account behavior and the wildcard redirect to / remain unchanged

inbox-conversation-query.query: A valid UUID conversation parameter redirects to the conversation route; conversation and view are removed and all other parameters are preserved

public-entry.classification: public route or anonymous entry surface; actions inside may still be gated

public-record.classification: public only for a valid public record resolved by the owning component

signed-in-or-component-gated.classification: signed-in, profile-dependent, participation-dependent, owner-dependent, or feature-gated as resolved by the owning component and backend

role-restricted.classification: reviewer, moderator, staff, or administrator restricted
authority: authoritative backend role and policy controls

alias-inherits-target.classification: compatibility entry; effective access is inherited from the canonical target

external-approved-boundary.classification: external bridge selected only from the approved origin allowlist

approved-external-boundary.capabilityStatus: external; not inferred by this contract

zoneProfiles.infrastructure: Router/layout infrastructure; not a destination and not permission to restructure providers.
zoneProfiles.lower-risk-presentation: Public presentation surface; still governed by route, visual, accessibility, and rollback proof.
zoneProfiles.red-entry-only: Commune, Commons Circle, or Developer Forge. Entry links may be preserved; internals are excluded from initial navigation work.
zoneProfiles.red-and-orange-boundary: A protected-room internal that also intersects an orange-zone system. Both exclusions apply; it is not an approved initial-navigation entry.
zoneProfiles.orange-boundary: Surface intersects an orange-zone workflow or system. Navigation may preserve its exact route; its behavior and internals may not be mutated.

marketplace-addon-id.rule: Use only add-on IDs returned by the canonical catalog/provider. Do not synthesize navigation targets from arbitrary IDs.

developer-forge-draft-id.rule: Use only drafts returned for the authorized user.

developer-forge-submission-id.rule: Use only submissions returned for the authorized owner or assigned reviewer.

commune-room-slug.rule: Use canonical room slugs from the room registry or loaded room records.

commune-post-id.rule: Use only post IDs returned by canonical Commune data.

commons-conversation-id.rule: The route parameter is a UUID for a conversation returned to an authorized participant.

commons-public-handle.rule: Use only a canonical published Commons handle accepted by the public-profile parser and backend projection.

legal-policy-slug.rule: Use only slugs defined by legalPolicyPages.

living-library-category-slug.rule: Use only category IDs defined by livingLibraryBrowseCategories.

living-library-source-id.rule: Use only stable IDs resolved by resolveLivingLibrarySource; active, retired, folded, and successor-mapped records remain addressable.
